original_card.question: Is there a genuinely unsearched, explicitly bounded improvement to the selected packing?
methods: Search a named unclaimed canonical candidate domain with a reproducible partition.
Prove a stronger scoped relaxation or exact optimum for one named residual subproblem.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Check live PR overlap first, price both suppliers and distinguish a search best from an optimum. Report the word's packing cap from ceiling.ceiling() and the fraction of it realized; label packing gains as such.

first_step.inspect: Locate the selected packing source in the review and check live PRs for the same residual problem.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Define an unclaimed canonical domain and a favorable bound before starting a new search.
original_card.bottleneck_link: An actual paid-profile gain can improve the frontier up to the other supplier cap.
allowed_variations: One bounded residual packing instance or exact relaxation.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Rerunning an existing search with only a different seed as a separate mathematical contribution.

existing_checks.scope: Packing-independent ceiling for the selected paid profile under the one-unpaid-coordinate coverage and halving guard.
existing_checks.remaining: A changed word or model requires new pricing; a local packing search must name uncovered scope.

actual_scope: A joint rank-only CP-SAT search over the pinned PR #3200 T740 idle-axis domain, followed by an exact eight-stream operator replay of its best frozen candidate.
scope_change_reason: The donor explicitly assigned the goal of improving the best available kappa and asked to continue with OR-Tools. PR #3200 lists exact per-group optimization as an open question. A rank-only model found a numerically better hypothetical profile, but direct exact replay rejects this candidate. Cached related work includes PR #3199's four-idle-child exact-coordinate CP-SAT screen, PR #3204's broader four-site rigidity result, and PR #3220's additive repair-cost bound. This package contributes a concrete global rank-only false positive involving partially hosted donors, not a new supplier or kappa.
bottleneck_link: The rank-only histogram improves the conditional complex moment, but the exact physical operator changes at one T740 group. This establishes why the operator-equality gate must enter any optimization before a numerical profile can count as a kappa improvement.
stop_rule: Stop when the exact operator replay rejects the best saved rank-only candidate; do not continue rank-only seed or runtime searches. Preserve the counterexample and make the next search include exact operator constraints.
evidence: RANK-ONLY-MOVES.json.gz and RANK-ONLY-RESULT.json retain the OR-Tools FEASIBLE candidate and hypothetical moment/root. verify.py first authenticates and checks the PR #3200 baseline and rank-only move rules, then uses the merged source-bound eight-stream replay to reproduce a matrix mismatch at character 2^53 for owner replica 0 / port 0. The cached overlap snapshot was complete as of 2026-10-17 18:40 UTC and exposed related PRs #3199, #3204 and #3220; a fresh network query failed, so the snapshot is dated. No new admissible kappa is claimed; the selected record is unchanged. A repeat with the same seed/time limit/workers returned only the baseline rank profile, so parallel incumbent discovery is nondeterministic.
author: Codex (OpenAI), under the user’s explicit research direction
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including the OR-Tools rank-only model, exact source-bound replay integration and package preparation.

open_questions.question: Can exchanges involving partially hosted donors preserve the exact eight-stream operator while changing net ranks?
open_questions.why_it_matters: This counterexample rejects the best rank-only incumbent, but does not prove all exchange patterns invalid; a valid operator-preserving profile change could still raise a supplier endpoint.
open_questions.first_step: Derive exact per-character constraints for one representative eight-child T740 port pattern, including children 8, 10, 12, 14 and 15, then screen all rank-changing assignments in that bounded group.
open_questions.blocked_by: The current optimization encodes rank, source-axis uniqueness, orthogonality, translations and role constraints, but not the coupled physical operator equality.

open_questions.question: Can the global optimizer include exact operator constraints without exceeding practical memory and runtime?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The previous 600-second eight-worker run was killed before it emitted evidence; smaller exact blocks could make an admissible optimization tractable.
open_questions.first_step: Use the source-bound phase tables from the idle-star operator screen on a single repeated pattern, then aggregate only independently certified pattern optima.
open_questions.blocked_by: The global CP-SAT model has 139,038 transfer variables, and the operator constraint domain is not yet derived for all eight children.
